frozenCausalDiscriminators.extentOnlyHypothesis: For non-endpoint states, target center does not enter the primary producer ROI. Conditional on realized k, all four 640-point geometries obey the same primary-edge function of clipped allocation bounds and runtime scale.
frozenCausalDiscriminators.targetCenterPhaseHypothesis: The target center enters Core Animation's producer ROI before the endpoint, so integer and half-pixel target phases retain distinct one-pixel residual signatures even though the presentation carrier and allocation bounds are center-independent.
frozenCausalDiscriminators.decisionRule: Evaluate the already-opened asymmetric quad4 candidate without changing it. Residuals unique to half-pixel targets support target-center phase; comparable residuals on centered and translated-integer controls support missing extent/temporal arithmetic. A mixed result retains both inputs. No post-opening expression is promoted without a later preregistered transfer.
